data.content:
Matchweek: 9

Date and time: October 27, 2026, 20:45 Central European Time, 19:45 UTC

Place: Stadio Olimpico, Rome, Italy [...] Toobit

Roma's 2-0 win over Genoa posed an awkward question for Cagliari. Gian Piero Gasperini's side found two second-half goals without Paulo Dybala or the suspended Donyell Malen, but Genoa had already shown how difficult Roma's first pass could become under pressure. Cagliari's best chance of taking something from the Olimpico may depend on exploiting that hesitation, not simply defending their penalty area.

Competition: Serie A Enilive 2026/27

Matchweek: 9 [...] Possible XI: Caprile; Zé Pedro, Mina, Juan Rodríguez, Obert; Romano, Winks, Massolin; Adopo, Maldini; Mendy. Predicted, not confirmed.

Fadera could replace Adopo if Pisacane wants a faster run into the space behind Roma's wingback. Nzola could give the first long pass a different aerial target in place of Mendy. Both changes would affect how Cagliari leave their own half. The Monza and Bologna games, and the squads that follow, may also change the personnel case before the trip to Rome.

## AS Roma predicted lineup

Possible AS Roma starting XI:Gollini; Balerdi, Ndicka, Koulierakis; Lulli, De Roon, Cristante, Molina; Mora, Soule; Malen

## When will the match kick off?

The match will kick off at 8:45pm BST on Tuesday, 27th October.

## How to watch AS Roma vs Cagliari? [...] Gasperini has several important players unavailable for the visit of Cagliari. First-choice goalkeeper Mile Svilar is out, as are midfielder Manu Koné and former captain Lorenzo Pellegrini.

There is better news in central midfield, however, with Bryan Cristante having recovered from a knock and expected to start.

The main doubt is Paulo Dybala, who has rejoined group training after missing three matches with a calf problem but is likely to be named among the substitutes.
